7. Target product and store [general search skips product lookup]

g.text: 8. [product selected] verify Shop ownership; resolve target category and price

path.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237));

g.text: 9. user.findMany(active, not deleted, KYC VERIFIED; include profile/tier/socialChannels)
10. Eligible KOLs with tier, bio and social channels

g.text: 11. Promise.all: order.findMany(DELIVERED/COMPLETED, include orderItems);
clickTrafficLog.groupBy(collaboratorId, isValid = true, isUnique = true)
12. Successful order items and valid unique click counts

path.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237));

g.text: 13. Aggregate each KOL: item referral owner, falling back to order attribution;
count each order once per KOL; collect category units, prices and clicks; deduplicate channels

path.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237));

g.text: 14. [category specified] require textMatchesCategory(...) sales/profile evidence;
apply category, minimum CR, minimum tier and price-range filters

path.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237));

g.text: 15. Calculate weighted score: category 35%, CR 25%, tier/social 20%, price 20%;
dampen CR score for low click volume; clamp rounded score to 0–100

path.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(237, 237, 237));

g.text: 16. generateAiReasoning(...); generateKeyStrengths(...);
sort by matchScore DESC then CR DESC; slice(0, limit || 5)
17. AiRecommendationResponseDto { targetProduct?, totalKolsScanned, recommendedKols, calculatedAt }
18. 200 OK — recommendations
19. Results; ignore stale requests and verify the selected product
20. Show up to 5 KOLs with scores, category evidence, confidence and reasoning
